name: modernbert-base-32k
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from answerdotai/ModernBERT-base (config.json max_position_embeddings 8192). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder, alternating local (128) and global attention (every 3rd layer)
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A finetune of answerdotai/ModernBERT-base, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.15 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-01-07. CAVEAT: three of eight rows win and five tie, all on a nine-row card table with no harness described. 'Perplexity @ 32K = 1.00' for both models is a suspiciously round figure and the card's own note says the model still fails retrieval beyond ~1K tokens, so the gains are small-sample position probes rather than a demonstrated 4x usable context. Recorded because the table has both columns and three rows are strictly higher.
